notes: Read from the local checkout /Users/ar/Development/projects/wisal-project/wisaladmin (v1.0.36+49), not cloned. The app is phone-first (no rail/drawer/data tables), so phone format. Theme: light, ReadexPro from the repo, primary #087443; icons are the real Solar glyphs rendered from the local solar_community_icons font. Home is drawn scrolled down one screen (the first four groups hold only 1-2 tiles each); the fixed greeting header and bottom bar are as in code. Sample data: admin/customer/consultant names, order ids, counters and amounts are invented; account codes and names on the trial balance are the real ones from the backend chart_of_accounts.py. Avatars are initials on a gradient (the app loads network photos). The date text in the two date pills is assumed to be yyyy-MM-dd (formatter lives in shared_utils, not checked in detail).
